SELECT USER_ID , USER_NAME_LOC AS USER_NAME , LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR /* 사용자정보 */ WHERE 1=1 AND COM_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND STATUS IN ('C','R') ORDER BY USER_NAME_LOC
